description:
[Wicked Memory] Store a memory (free, fair-use rate limited). A real embedding is computed at write time. Run memory_prepare with operation 'store' and these same arguments first.

Use when you want to save something for later, scoped to your wallet. Not for changing an existing memory (use memory_update).

Behavior: writes state upstream (not read-only); needs the credentials or wallet signature noted above where applicable.

signature.description: Your wallet's signature over memory_prepare's message_to_sign.

name: memory_store
